problems: Nicephorus Bryennius Prolegomena: OCR page numbers 5-14 absent, so no body column; Ordo and Elenchus both say 9.
Anastasius (De Artziburio, De jejunio): OCR page numbers 517-521 absent; heads found at lines 39475/39494 but no column read.

Nicon De jejunio Deiparae: Elenchus Ibid. = a stub at 516 pointing infra col. 523; the real text sits at 523+, but the running head NICONIS MONACHI begins at 523 while the Greek TOY AGIOY NIKONOS head is at line 39974 (col ~525/526), so the exact opening of Nicon's text is not settled.
Nicolaus crossref col numbers are as the OCR reads them (Decreta 162 is unconfirmed; may be 862).

Items in the volume that the Elenchus does not list but the Ordo does: Nicetas Serronius Anthologium Gnomicum (OCR col ~1150), Sententiae Gnosticae (~1117/1148), Expositiones in Orationes XXXVII/XXXIX/XLI/XLII (1177, 1212, 1301, XLII garbled), Addenda (1477), Indices in Bryennium and in Manassem (1487 ff.). Not entered, since the Elenchus omits them.
Elenchus cut ended at line 520 with the full list present; the Elenchus omits the Typicum column's readable digit ('383').
